title: Donut Battery 的锂质量分数会低于 0.1% 吗？
Will the Donut Battery contain less than 0.1% lithium by weight?
rules: 规则以锂质量分数低于 0.1% 为 Yes，达到或超过该值为 No。
Yes requires lithium below 0.1% by weight; at least 0.1% resolves No.
interpretation: 需要能对应到被测电池的第三方成分证据；快充、能量密度或公司“无锂”说法不能替代成分分析。
Independent composition evidence must identify the tested battery. Charging speed, energy density and company descriptions do not establish elemental composition.

summary: 预测的是锂含量，不是测试会不会发生。原题的 Yes 门槛为质量分数低于 0.1%。
This predicts lithium content, not whether testing occurs: Yes requires less than 0.1% by weight.
checklist: 核对 Intertek 原报告的取样范围与质量分母。
Check the Intertek report’s sample scope and mass denominator.
区分送检组分、完整电芯与量产批次，确认它们和题目对象的对应关系。
Match submitted parts, complete cells and production batches to the contract subject.
对照原市场的后续澄清；报告结果不自动替代平台结算。
Review source clarifications; laboratory results do not substitute for platform resolution.

stage: 送检数据 → 商品验证 → 客户交付
Submitted tests → product validation → delivery
impact: 锂含量报告直接关联本题的化学门槛，比快充或能量密度宣传更贴近 Yes／No 条件。市场解读应从“哪种组分被测、是否对应题目电池”开始，而不是只看公司宣称使用了新技术。
The elemental report bears directly on the chemical threshold, unlike charge-rate or energy-density marketing. Interpretation starts with sample scope and correspondence to the contract battery.
gap: 一份送检组分报告仍需与题目对象、质量分母和创建者澄清对应。下方消息附近的价格对照只能描述成交，不能证明市场为何没有接受或采纳某项材料。
The report must match the contract subject, mass denominator and clarifications. Nearby prices describe trades, not why traders accepted or rejected evidence.

title: 指定车企能否在 2030 年内完成 Donut 电池乘用车交付？
Will a listed automaker deliver a Donut-powered passenger vehicle by the end of 2030?
rules: 限原规则列出的 19 家车企、合法上路的量产乘用车，以及明确使用 Donut 主动力电池的车型。至少一名非员工零售客户须实际收车。
Restricted to the 19 named automakers, road-legal production passenger vehicles and an explicitly identified Donut traction battery. A non-employee retail customer must receive a vehicle.
interpretation: 预订、概念车和测试样车不算交付；Verge 摩托车也不在这一乘用车市场的适用范围内。
Preorders, concept cars and test vehicles do not qualify. Verge motorcycles fall outside this passenger-car contract.

summary: 预测零售乘用车是否实际交付。实验电芯存在、摩托车发布和乘用车收车不是同一事件。
This predicts actual retail passenger-car delivery, not a laboratory cell or motorcycle launch.
checklist: 确认车企在原规则 19 家名单内。
Confirm the automaker is in the source list of 19.
找到明确电池型号与已交付车辆的对应记录。
Match the identified battery to a delivered vehicle.
核对非员工零售客户实际收车，而非预订或内部试车。
Verify receipt by a non-employee retail buyer, rather than a preorder or internal test.

stage: 送检数据 → 商品验证 → 客户交付
Submitted tests → product validation → delivery
impact: 企业检测资料能减少对实验样品性能的疑问，但本题最终关心商品可得性或客户交付。进展只有在对应到实际车型、电池型号和原题所指购买行为后，才触及交付门槛。
Tests inform sample performance, while this contract concerns availability or delivery. The relevant link requires an identified vehicle, battery and qualifying purchase or receipt.
gap: 当前引用的元素和能量密度测试没有提供非员工客户收车凭证，也不确定交付车型一定采用同一电池。不能把实验确认直接写成商业交付已经完成。
The cited tests do not establish customer receipt or that delivered vehicles use the tested cell. Experimental evidence does not complete the delivery condition.

title: 消费者能否购买低于 5 万美元的固态电池摩托车？
Will a solid-state motorcycle be purchasable below US$50,000?
rules: 原题以 2026 年结束前可以买到符合条件的摩托车为判断对象，价格门槛为 5 万美元。
The original question asks about availability before the end of 2026 with a US$50,000 price ceiling.
interpretation: 购买资格、订单与实际交付并不相同；原描述细则有限，判断前须查看市场创建者的解释。
Availability, ordering and physical delivery differ. The description supplies limited detail; review the creator’s clarifications.

summary: 预测价格低于 5 万美元的固态电池摩托车能否在原题期限内买到；仅七位参与者，规则细节有限。
This asks whether a sub-US$50,000 solid-state motorcycle becomes purchasable by the deadline; activity and rule detail are limited.
checklist: 查价格是否包含原题要求的配置、市场和币种。
Check configuration, jurisdiction and currency against the source rule.
分清可下单、可交付和客户已收到。
Distinguish ordering, availability and receipt.
核实商品所用电池，不能只引用供应商实验样品。
Verify the product’s battery rather than only a supplier’s laboratory cell.

stage: 送检数据 → 商品验证 → 客户交付
Submitted tests → product validation → delivery
impact: 企业检测资料能减少对实验样品性能的疑问，但本题最终关心商品可得性或客户交付。进展只有在对应到实际车型、电池型号和原题所指购买行为后，才触及交付门槛。
Tests inform sample performance, while this contract concerns availability or delivery. The relevant link requires an identified vehicle, battery and qualifying purchase or receipt.
gap: 当前引用的元素和能量密度测试没有提供非员工客户收车凭证，也不确定交付车型一定采用同一电池。不能把实验确认直接写成商业交付已经完成。
The cited tests do not establish customer receipt or that delivered vehicles use the tested cell. Experimental evidence does not complete the delivery condition.

title: LLZO 固态电池能否达到 2029 年商业生产门槛？
Will LLZO solid-state packs reach the 2029 commercial-production threshold?
rules: 要求 LLZO 石榴石电解质路线，单个设施年化至少 1 GWh，并核对商业交付及生产运行证据。
Requires LLZO garnet chemistry, at least 1 GWh annualized at a single facility, with commercial-delivery and production evidence.
interpretation: 公告中的未来产能不等于实际运行；硫化物路线或低于门槛的中试生产不满足同一标准。
Announced future capacity is not an operating run rate. Sulfide chemistry and below-threshold pilots do not meet this contract.

summary: 预测 2029 年窗口的 LLZO 商业生产门槛：重点是指定路线和单一设施的实际年化产出。
This is the 2029 LLZO production threshold: specified chemistry and actual annualized output at one facility.
checklist: 确认电解质确为 LLZO；硫化物路线不能混入。
Confirm LLZO chemistry; exclude sulfide routes.
查至少 1 GWh/年运行与商业交付依据，不用设计产能代替。
Check evidence of at least 1 GWh/year and commercial deliveries, not design capacity.
与 2027 题分别阅读；两个题的参与人群和截止条件不同。
Read separately from the 2027 contract, which has different participants and deadlines.

stage: 界面研究 → 连续制造 → 单设施商业产出
Interface studies → manufacturing → facility output
impact: 界面研究影响循环与制造难度，产线和客户认证则影响可量产性。QS 的中试进展可作为放大环节的产业对照；它没有在这份公告中证明采用 LLZO，不能据此计入本题产量。
Interface work informs cycling/manufacturing constraints; production and customer qualification matter to scale. QS is an industrial scale-up comparator, not verified LLZO output.
gap: 仍需要一家满足 LLZO 路线的设施给出至少 1 GWh/年的实际运行和商业交付证据。不能合并多个工厂、不同电解质路线或计划中的容量。
The threshold still needs actual operation and commercial evidence for one qualifying LLZO facility at ≥1 GWh/year, not combined factories or planned capacity.

title: LLZO 固态电池能否达到 2027 年商业生产门槛？
Will LLZO solid-state packs reach the 2027 commercial-production threshold?
rules: 核对单个设施至少 1 GWh 年化产量和 LLZO 电解质路线；时间边界与 2029 年市场不同。
Checks a single-facility annualized 1 GWh threshold and LLZO chemistry, with a different horizon from the 2029 market.
interpretation: 两个期限的事件是独立市场，不能合并为一条概率，也不能把它们的成交额重复计作同一订单。
The two horizons are separate contracts, not one probability series or a shared order-volume measure.

summary: 预测较早的 2027 年 LLZO 放大门槛。材料界面论文能解释难点，不能证明工厂已经过关。
This asks about the earlier 2027 LLZO threshold. Interface research explains obstacles but does not certify factory output.
checklist: 核查 2027 时间条件及一个设施的实际产量。
Check the 2027 condition and output of one facility.
核实工艺、电芯路线与商业交付对象。
Verify process, cell chemistry and commercial recipients.
比较 2029 题的宽限时间，但不要把不同市场概率当作同一分布。
Compare the later deadline without treating separate market prices as one coherent distribution.

stage: 界面研究 → 连续制造 → 单设施商业产出
Interface studies → manufacturing → facility output
impact: 界面研究影响循环与制造难度，产线和客户认证则影响可量产性。QS 的中试进展可作为放大环节的产业对照；它没有在这份公告中证明采用 LLZO，不能据此计入本题产量。
Interface work informs cycling/manufacturing constraints; production and customer qualification matter to scale. QS is an industrial scale-up comparator, not verified LLZO output.
gap: 仍需要一家满足 LLZO 路线的设施给出至少 1 GWh/年的实际运行和商业交付证据。不能合并多个工厂、不同电解质路线或计划中的容量。
The threshold still needs actual operation and commercial evidence for one qualifying LLZO facility at ≥1 GWh/year, not combined factories or planned capacity.

title: QuantumScape 与 PowerCo 的 Unified Cell 样品确认
QuantumScape and PowerCo Unified Cell sample confirmation
rules: 要求双方通过官方材料确认 QS 陶瓷隔膜进入 PowerCo Unified Cell 格式，且至少产出一个样品。
Requires official confirmation that QS ceramic separators enter PowerCo’s Unified Cell format and at least one sample exists.
interpretation: 原题标题写 2026，正文截止写 2025，存在实质冲突。这里保留异常，不按某一个年份替创建者作解释。
The title names 2026 while the rule text specifies 2025. This conflict is preserved rather than resolved on the creator’s behalf.

summary: 预测 QS 陶瓷隔膜进入 PowerCo Unified Cell 格式并产出样品的官方确认；原题标题和描述年份冲突仍需查看。
This asks for confirmation of a QS separator in PowerCo Unified Cell samples; the title/body year conflict remains material.
checklist: 回到原市场确认适用的年份和澄清。
Resolve the applicable year through source clarifications.
找双方明确提及 Unified Cell 格式与隔膜集成的文件。
Find both parties’ explicit format and integration disclosures.
区分中试线设备安装、样品生产和客户格式确认。
Distinguish equipment installation, samples and customer-format confirmation.

stage: 工艺设备 → 样品 → 客户格式确认
Process equipment → sample → format confirmation
impact: Eagle Line 设备安装与 Cobra 工艺说明 QS 正在推进制造链条。对这个市场，真正相关的下一道信息是双方是否明确把陶瓷隔膜、Unified Cell 格式和实物样品联系起来。
Eagle Line/Cobra progress concerns manufacturing. The contract-relevant next disclosure would explicitly connect the separator, Unified Cell format and an actual sample from both parties.
gap: 设备、QSE-5 样品与 PowerCo 客户格式确认不能互相代替。并且原题存在年份冲突，应先核对澄清，不能根据产线新闻自行延后截止。
Equipment, QSE-5 samples and customer-format confirmation are different. The year conflict also requires source clarification rather than moving the deadline to suit later news.

title: 超过 400 Wh/kg 的固态电池能否在 2024 年商业发布？
Would a solid-state battery above 400 Wh/kg be commercially released in 2024?
rules: 原规则要求超过能量密度门槛，并能商业购买或订购；平台已判定 No。
The rule requires exceeding the energy-density threshold and commercial purchase or ordering; the platform resolved No.
interpretation: 单个实验样品达到数值，不自动满足商业可购条件；平台结算也不能替代所有电池产品的技术审查。
A laboratory sample does not automatically establish commercial availability. Settlement is not a technical review of every battery product.

summary: 这是已判 No 的历史商业发布题。它同时要求比能量超过 400 Wh/kg 和原窗口内可商业购买或订购。
A resolved-No historical release contract required both over 400 Wh/kg and commercial availability within its window.
checklist: 查当时商品的测试条件与电芯质量口径。
Check contemporaneous test conditions and cell-mass basis.
查截止前真实商业购买／订购的证据。
Check actual commercial purchase or ordering before the deadline.
把后来的 VTT 报告作为技术后续阅读，不回填成旧窗口的 Yes。
Treat the later VTT report as subsequent context, not a retroactive Yes.

stage: 实验指标 → 可购买产品 → 截止内交付
Lab metric → purchasable product → timely delivery
impact: 测试和合作公告解释技术后续发展，但这两份历史合同在更早窗口已结束。后来超过某个实验指标，不能替代原截止前商业可购或交付的证据。
Tests and partnerships explain subsequent development, but these historical contracts ended earlier. A later laboratory metric cannot establish timely availability or delivery.
gap: 对已经结算的市场，保留当时价格和结果；把后续企业发展单独阅读，不回填历史信息集。
Keep historical prices and resolutions, with later corporate progress outside the original information window.

Tests and partnerships explain subsequent development, but these historical contracts ended earlier. A later laboratory metric cannot establish timely availability or delivery.

title: Apple 是否推出使用固态电池的 iPhone？
Will Apple release an iPhone using a solid-state battery?
rules: 原题期限为 2026 年结束前，指向使用固态电池的 iPhone 产品发布。
The question concerns an iPhone release using a solid-state battery before the end of 2026.
interpretation: 描述仅提供电池概念链接，没有完整定义固态比例、样机与零售版本的区别。相关缺口保持可见。
The description links a general battery definition without defining solid fraction or prototype versus retail release.

summary: 预测的是已发布 iPhone 的电池路线，不能用续航提升或快充宣传证明固态化。
This predicts the battery chemistry of a released iPhone, not a general improvement in endurance or charging.
checklist: 查看具体型号的产品技术说明与可复核电芯资料。
Review model-specific technical and cell evidence.
向原市场核对固态定义及“发布”的验收含义。
Check the source definition of solid-state and release.
保留 2026 期限；下一代型号传闻不作为已完成事件。
Respect the 2026 condition; rumors about later models are not completed events.

stage: 产品宣传 → 型号技术披露 → 可复核电芯
Product messaging → model disclosure → verifiable cell
impact: 对 Apple 这类产品题，材料是否进入已发布型号，比专利、供应商传闻或更长续航更直接。官方电池说明能解释充电控制，却不能单凭这份通用资料判定新型号已改用固态。
For this Apple question, adoption in a released model is more direct than patents, rumors or endurance improvements. General charging guidance does not establish a model’s electrolyte.
gap: 还缺少对应型号和固态定义的完整验收资料。若企业没有公开化学路线，应保留未知，不根据续航数字反推配方。
Model-specific evidence and an acceptance definition are still needed. Undisclosed chemistry remains unknown rather than inferred from endurance.

title: Toyota 固态电池汽车能否同时达到续航与充电目标？
Will Toyota’s solid-state cars meet both range and charging targets?
rules: 原题要求 2030 年前销售、续航至少 1000 km、充电少于 15 分钟，并采用固态电池。
The question combines sales before 2030, at least 1,000 km range, charging under 15 minutes and solid-state batteries.
interpretation: 四个条件需要同时核对。原题未充分给出续航测试工况和充电区间，不把宣传中的不同测试数字拼成一次验证。
All conditions require review. Range test cycles and charging intervals are underspecified; separate promotional measurements must not be combined.

summary: 原题把 2030 年前销售、至少 1000 km、少于 15 分钟充电和固态电池放在同一条件里；平台停盘字段早于题目期限。
The question combines pre-2030 sales, ≥1,000 km, <15-minute charging and solid-state chemistry; the API close field is earlier than the textual deadline.
checklist: 同一款量产车同时满足原题的所有条件。
Verify all conditions for the same production vehicle.
核对续航测试工况及充电起止 SOC、温度与功率。
Check range cycle and charge SOC, temperature and power.
停盘字段与题目期限不一致，不能将其中一个直接当成另一个。
Keep the API-close/textual-deadline mismatch explicit.

stage: 材料供应 → 耐久性 → 车型认证与销售
Material supply → durability → vehicle qualification/sales
impact: 出光合作触及硫化物材料供应和大型中试，能说明供应链如何为整车开发做准备。路线图提供性能目标，但只有同一款销售车辆的规格和实测工况，才能同时对应本题的三项要求。
Idemitsu cooperation addresses sulfide supply and pilots. A roadmap explains targets; evidence for one sold model is needed to connect the contract’s combined performance requirements.
gap: 未据这些公告确认已经销售符合全部条件的车型。另有停盘字段与文本期限的差异，不能把商业计划或市场元数据误写成完成日期。
These announcements do not establish a qualifying vehicle sale. The API-close/text mismatch remains distinct from any corporate target.

title: 2033 年前能否发现并测得室温常压超导？
Will a room-temperature ambient-pressure superconductor be demonstrated before 2033?
rules: 原规则要求发现、合成和测量；其室温定义为 0–30 °C，常压为 0.5–2 atm。
Requires discovery, synthesis and measurement; this contract defines room temperature as 0–30 °C and ambient pressure as 0.5–2 atm.
interpretation: 这些范围属于这个市场的定义。其他题目可能用不同温度、压力或证据标准，概率不应直接混合。
These are contract-specific definitions. Other markets may use different temperature, pressure or evidential requirements.

summary: 这是材料发现、合成与测量题，原规则把室温定为 0–30 °C、常压定为 0.5–2 atm，并非商品销售题。
A material discovery/synthesis/measurement contract defines 0–30 °C and 0.5–2 atm; it is not a product-sales forecast.
checklist: 确认实验温度、压力落在原规则区间。
Check temperature and pressure against the defined ranges.
核对材料身份、电输运与磁学证据的完整性。
Review material identity, transport and magnetic evidence.
区分一项实验结果、独立复现和可销售器件。
Distinguish a result, independent replication and a saleable device.

stage: 材料复现 → 导体加工 → 器件商品
Material replication → conductor processing → device
